title: App crashes on startup
content: The app crashes every time I try to open it on my iPhone 15. I have reinstalled it twice and the problem persists. This is really frustrating since I need it for work.

title: Love the new dashboard
content: The new dashboard design is amazing! Everything is so easy to find and the charts look great. Really love the color scheme too.

title: Need dark mode
content: It would be great if you could add a dark mode option. I work late at night and the bright white background hurts my eyes. Please consider adding this feature.

title: Slow loading times
content: Pages take forever to load especially the reports section. Sometimes it takes over 10 seconds just to see my data. This needs to be optimized for better performance.

title: Feature request: export to PDF
content: I would like to be able to export my reports to PDF format. Currently I can only export to CSV which is not ideal for sharing with stakeholders. This feature would be incredibly helpful.

title: Great customer support
content: Your support team is fantastic! They helped me resolve my billing issue in under 5 minutes. Really appreciate the quick and friendly service.

title: Wrong data in charts
content: The pie chart on the overview page is showing incorrect numbers. The total adds up to more than 100% and some categories are missing. This seems like a bug in the calculation logic.

title: Wish there was a mobile app
content: I love using the web version but I really wish there was a native mobile app. It would be so much more convenient to check my data on the go. Can you please develop one?

title: Battery drain issue
content: This app is draining my battery like crazy. My phone goes from 100% to 50% in just 2 hours of using it. Never had this problem with other similar apps. Please fix this performance issue.

title: Excellent onboarding experience
content: The onboarding flow is really well designed. I was able to set up my account and understand all the features in less than 10 minutes. The tooltips and guided tour are a nice touch!
